purpose: Teach: コロコロ/サブタイトル/タイツ/トラバ/スバ/ジモン/背番号/ケタ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがコロコロ転がるおもちゃをお孫様にプレゼントされた
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, your father gave our grandchild that rolling toy as a present.
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. Gentle curiosity in the voice — testing whether she remembers too. Slight pause before the payoff.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、洋画のサブタイトル付きを観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you watched those foreign films with subtitles back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing deflection. A gentle tease wrapped in affection. Quick tempo, playful lilt at the question mark. Not giving him the satisfaction of a straight answer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、私が冬にタイツを愛用していた
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, I wore tights all through the winters.
lines.style: Quieter now, more personal. Almost embarrassed admitting this small detail about himself. Measured breath. The vulnerability of sharing something nobody asked about.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、初期のブログでトラバ、つまりトラックバックを使われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were using trackbacks on your blog in those early days, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright recognition. Caught him in a memory. Quick and satisfied. Gentle ribbing — she knows exactly what he's doing and won't let him get away with it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフィジー首都スバに出張された
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, your father took a business trip to Suva, Fiji.
lines.style: Offering up another small fact, like pieces of a puzzle he's arranging. Thoughtful pauses. The tenderness of an old man sharing what he remembers about the people he loved.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、寺門ジモンの番組を毎週観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You watched that Teradon Jimon show every week back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Triumphant and warm. She's found her rhythm now — she knows how this dance goes. Quick, assured delivery. The comfortable victory of a long marriage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが野球の背番号3を尊敬された
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, your father really respected the baseball player wearing number three.
lines.style: Softer still, almost reverent. The respect in his voice mirrors the respect he's describing. Slow, deliberate. Like he's honoring something precious across the years.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、給料がケタ違いに上がった経験あったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: There was that time your salary jumped up dramatically when you were young, wasn't there, dear?
lines.style: Warm closing. Knowing smile in the voice. Intimate, familiar rhythm. Settling into the comfortable silence that comes after a lifetime of these small exchanges.
